title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Porsche 918 Spyder
description:
The Porsche nine eighteen Spyder hides two secrets that you cannot see from the outside, and one you can. The exhaust pipes come out of the top of the car, above the engine, and Porsche says no other production vehicle does that. The rear wheels steer. And a button on the steering wheel called Hot Lap spends the battery's last reserves for a few fast laps. These are the facts, with every figure sourced. We use Porsche's own twenty thirteen press release as published by 911uk, a March twenty twelve report from Auto one two three, and Wikipedia, Car and Driver's figures as quoted there, evo, and the duPont Registry. Where Porsche's own figures changed over time, we show how. Where sources disagree, we show both. And all arithmetic is ours, and labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
